I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual inputs.

Please provide:
1) The full transcript of the doctor-patient encounter.
2) The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Notes:

- I will not invent data (vitals, lab values, etc.) beyond what is present in the transcript or DDx.
- I will produce the note with the exact structure and headings you specified:
  - Subjective
  - Objective
  - Assessment & Plan (with Issue 1, Issue 2, etc.)
  - Quality checks at the bottom

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON here.
